sessionTimelineAnalysis.method: MP4 creation_time tags, filesystem metadata, filenames, and human visual inspection of deterministic audit contact sheets; no model inference.
notes: Filesystem modified times are import/copy-like and span only seconds, so MP4 creation_time was treated as the more informative timestamp when available.

Groups are source-level recommendations for future planning only; no TRAIN/HOLDOUT split is assigned here.
sessionTimelineAnalysis.overallInterpretation: Ants2-Ants10 appear to be same-device, same-morning source material with several visually distinct setups; Ants11 appears to be a separate recording day and the most own_colony_val-like source. True biological/session continuity remains uncertain from metadata alone.
